summary: HUTCHMED (China) Limited filed a Form 6-K with an announcement of positive Phase III SANOVO trial results. The trial showed statistically significant progression-free survival improvement for ORPATHYS plus TAGRISSO versus TAGRISSO alone in treatment-naive EGFR-mutated MET-overexpressing non-small cell lung cancer patients in China. This is a clinical data disclosure, not a corporate special situation. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, activist, or management change events. It is a routine regulatory update on drug development progress, and therefore does not qualify as a special situation.
